title: Konbini: Quick Lunch Stop
subtitle: Buying lunch at a Japanese convenience store

sentences.en: Welcome. Will you use a point card today?
sentences.target: いらっしゃいませ。本日はポイントカードをお使いになりますか?

sentences.en: No, I do not have one.
sentences.target: いいえ、持っていません。

sentences.en: Would you like the rice ball warmed up?
sentences.target: おにぎりは温めますか?

sentences.en: No, that is fine as it is.
sentences.target: いいえ、そのままで大丈夫です。

sentences.en: Would you like the bento warmed up?

sentences.target: お箸はおつけしますか?

sentences.en: Yes, please give me one pair.
sentences.target: はい、一膳お願いします。

sentences.en: The total is one thousand and twenty yen.
sentences.target: お会計は千二十円でございます。

sentences.en: I will pay with my IC card.
